parsedVerdict.reasoning: All three files handle one concern: they are thin Express HTTP adapters that turn requests into use-case calls and use-case results into JSON responses. Each controller is a class that receives its application use cases through the constructor (CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS edges). Each one exposes arrow-function handlers with the signature (req: Request, res: Response) => Promise<void>. All of them read input through the shared helpers requireString and optionalString from ../requestParsing. None of them parses input inline or duplicates a validation rule, and none contains business logic. Domain rules stay in the use cases. Status codes follow the same pattern everywhere: 201 for create and the default 200 for reads and updates. ProjectController and UserController look alike, but only because they share the same thin create/list shape. That is not a duplicated invariant.
